{{Class Template|number_of_champions = 10|non-playable = 0|class_bonus = [[Demolitions]]|weakness = [[Scout]]|title1 = |image1 = File:Class Use Tech.png}}'''[[Tech]]'''s are one of six Bot Classes in ''[[Transformers: Forged to Fight]]''. It has a Class Bonus against [[Demolitions]] bots, but is weak to [[Scout]]s.

== In-Game Description ==
''Tech Bots generate shields, manipulate Power, and equip some of the most advanced custom weaponry.'' 
*Tech Bots specialize in Shields, [[Shock]] debuffs, and [[Power]] control.
*Their shielding abilities are effective against the high-damage attacks of [[Demolition]] Bots.

== Strategies ==
Tech Bots in their respective canons are usually smart, like the resident [[Autobot]] inventor, [[Wheeljack]]. Same goes for their depiction in ''Forged to Fight'', where this intelligence is mapped into unique abilities that they're able to use in a fight to fend off Bots of all kinds and types. Well... especially [[Demolitions]] Bots. Most Tech Bots love to utilize shields, repairs, power-related abilities, and... any type of defensive ability to successfully fend off the opponent. With a Tech, you'll be fighting strong with them.

Most Tech bots use Shields to increase defensive resistance, but Life steal, instant energy attacks and damaging debuffs can go through them, so some Demolitions Bots and some [[Warrior]]s (well any bot who can inflict either) can still show down against a Tech and win. Sometimes, even pure intelligence can be outsmarted.

== Brain Drain/Gain ==
This class is unique in particular to have a special synergy exclusive to the class in general. [[Shockwave]] has a '''Brain Drain/Gain''' Synergy that activates with fellow Tech buddies of his (and only with Tech buds) regardless of faction and rarity.

==List of Tech Bots==
*[[Rhinox]]
*[[Ratchet]]
*[[Mirage]]
*[[Soundwave]]
*[[Shockwave]]
*[[Blaster]]
*Tech [[Sharkticon]]
*[[Wheeljack]]
*[[Jetfire]]
*[[Skywarp]]
